57% declared evidence coverage

Equal-count declared evidence coverage; not percentage of MeRSIA achieved, work remaining or probability of success. Gates have unequal difficulty.

Manual project assessment against explicit gates. Finite fixture results are inspectable; wider gates remain unmet.
